### Two-way counter-proof

- "Only do the plan change" at 13.29 or the price-sheet rate: excluded by the two state-form sentences in the authorization card and by "re-priced from the contract rate already in force" + factor docs; price-sheet offer excluded by "rather than the price-sheet offer" and Article 6 (retired price-offer clause).
- Rebill both over-billed lines: excluded — 2026-08 line's correction exceeds 150.00 ("not posted as a rebill credit but referred to billing review"), and rebill scope is "the most recently posted off-peak energy line".
- Dispute on the 2026-09 line: excluded — "opened on the off-peak energy line of the agreement with the largest billed amount" (164.80 > 116.95).
- Rebill before dispute: excluded by the rebill's state-form sentence (and the open-review courtesy would read 0 → 133.24).
- Sign-up credit cycle 2026-04-01 or 2026-10-01: excluded by "belongs to the billing cycle that follows the last qualifying cycle" and the table "it belongs to the fourth billing cycle".
- plan_change_date 2026-10-15 or contract end 2027-02-28: excluded by "takes effect at the start of the next billing cycle and the new term is counted from that date" + contract end rule.
- Fall-back numbers: 164.80, 116.95, 50.00, 13.29 — all computable from the computation docs and named product figures, all different.
- Factor findability: from record words — enrollment_date (protection), gas agreement status and plan (courtesies, bundle reduction), on-peak/off-peak kWh (usage, reliance, load-shift, volume, peak-cycle), line rate equal to contract rate (systemic), service_start_date (tenure), posted_date (late correction), dispute status (open-review, concession), contract_end_date (remaining-term), completed cycles (late posting), gas sign-up credit line (welcome).

### Observations for the comparison (not conclusions)

- Two definitions of completed cycles for sign-up credits: signup_and_online_credit_rules ("distinct billing cycles … whose billing period ended on or before the handling date … on-peak and off-peak lines of one cycle count once") vs signup_credit_posting / signup_late_posting_multiplier / signup_usage_bonus ("billing cycles that carry an on-peak or an all-hours energy charge line"). Same count (7) here.
- offpeak_disputed_amount: "Because such a line was billed at the full contract rate, its correctly billed amount is its billed amount multiplied by the plan's off-peak rate multiplier" — states a condition of the line as a fact; to compare with source.
- Computation docs presuppose modifiers ("Every per-kWh reduction … a multiplier acts on that combined reduction", "A multiplier acts on the over-billed amount; flat amounts are added"); hub phrases "rather than the bare over-billed amount"; plan_change_remaining_term_scaling names "the combined reduction on the plan-change rate (the per-kWh reductions on that rate added together into one figure)"; rebill_service_fee_return "before any multiplier".
- renewal_election_terms rule 5 "the customer may instead change plans under the plan change terms at the then-valid price offer" vs the authorization card's contract-rate re-pricing and Article 6 retiring the price-offer clause.
